races.verdict: WASHINGTON ROYALE has shaped with promise on all 3 starts in stronger company to date, latterly when fifth in a big-field Goodwood maiden 5 weeks ago. Remaining with potential for better still, he shades preference over Irish raider Ischgl who has shown enough himself to think a race of this nature is within his grasp. Beechwood Glory may emerge best of the remainder. WASHINGTON ROYALE ISCHGL (IRE) BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)

races.verdict: EDWARD SEXTON is very lightly raced on the Flat but mixed it with some smart sorts in bumpers and still looks ahead of his mark having been raised 5 lb for his Haydock win. races.verdict: Cases can be made for several, but the vote goes to JUST TYPICAL , who has dipped below his last winning mark and with a strong gallop likely, Ian Williams' 5-y-o can open his account for the campaign reunited with Billy Loughnane. Izzari stopped the slide from a tumbling mark when runner-up at Carlisle last time, so he can provide most resistance, with Aim For The Bull rounding off the shortlist back from a break. JUST TYPICAL IZZARI (GER) AIM FOR THE BULL (IRE)

races.verdict: Plenty in with a squeak but the vote goes to MERISI DIAMOND , who scrambled home at the Curragh back in April and Thomas Coyle's 7-y-o remains on a handy mark after just a 2 lb nudge. Provided he's ready to roll, he can enhance his good record here at the expense of another track-specialist Earls , with Ninth Crusade and Highbury See See a couple worthy of consideration, too.
